Before you begin

Consultation information

Arrange a time

Please message Uday on WhatsApp before paying so a suitable time can be discussed. Availability is 9 am–10 pm (IST). The available formats are phone call, Zoom, WhatsApp call and offline conversation, depending on what is arranged.

Introductory conversation

The introductory conversation is 30 minutes and is listed at ₹500.

Pay ₹500 for the introductory conversation

Payment support

If you have already paid, send your Razorpay payment reference on WhatsApp. Do not include card numbers, bank details, OTPs or passwords.

Duplicate payments

If the same customer accidentally pays twice for the same introductory conversation, the duplicate payment will be refunded within 1–2 days.

For urgent mental-health or safety concerns, contact local emergency services or a qualified crisis service.
